title: Say something
hint: Print your own words. Keep the quotation marks.
source:
Present "Hello, world!".

Present "One small idea can become a program.".
output:
Hello, world!
One small idea can become a program.

title: Write in paragraphs
hint: Quoted instructions can share a value across paragraphs.
source:
“Let total be a mutable integer with value 2.
Set total to the sum of total and 3.”

“Show total.”

title: A moment from today
hint: Turn a diary thought into printed lines.
source:
Present "Today, I made time to learn.".

Present "Tomorrow, I will try another small idea.".
output:
Today, I made time to learn.
Tomorrow, I will try another small idea.
